title: A regulatory issue closed out 16 months ago, price still below its pre-issue level

input.facts: Clinical chemistry analyzers with captive reagents; consumables and service are 61% of sales. The share price fell 32% after a one-off write-down and a slow product cycle. Leverage 2.6x. In early 2025 the FDA issued a warning letter on a manufacturing site. It was closed out in June 2025 after a clean re-inspection, 16 months ago, with no ongoing monitoring and no related observation since. The share price is still about 28% below its level before the warning letter. No holder above 25%. No other regulatory issue.

why: unnessarily depressed share price after a regulatory issue that has been resolved for 16 months and no other regulatory issues
